in_hebrew.name: Rockie
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Ruler of the People
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Rockie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Rokkos', meaning 'Ruler of the People'. In the New Testament, the name 'Rock' is used metaphorically to refer to Jesus as the foundation of the Christian faith.

in_greek.name: Rockie
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Ruler of the People
in_greek.long_meaning: Rockie είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Rokkos', meaning 'Ruler of the People'. In the New Testament, the name 'Rock' is used metaphorically to refer to Jesus as the foundation of the Christian faith.

in_latin.name: Rockie
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Ruler of the People
in_latin.long_meaning: Rockie est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Rokkos', meaning 'Ruler of the People'. In the New Testament, the name 'Rock' is used metaphorically to refer to Jesus as the foundation of the Christian faith.
